title: AniMax 1 tomato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: AniMax 1 tomato: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: AniMax 1 tomato is a tomato variety for Luzon. 59 to 63 days to harvest, 22.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: AniMax 1 is a registered tomato variety. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2015 as NSIC 2015 Tm 14. DA BPI Lbncrdc bred it. It takes 59 to 63 days from transplanting to the first harvest, with 22.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

AniMax 1 tomato takes 59 to 63 days from transplanting to the first harvest. That is 9.6 days faster than the average of the 20 tomato varieties with a day count, 70.6 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 22.82 t/ha beats the average of its group, 20.91. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives first harvest 59 days after transplanting in the dry season, 63 in the wet.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [leafminer](/pests/leafminer), [bacterial wilt](/diseases/bacterial-wilt).

The pests and diseases that hit tomato fields most often: [early blight](/diseases/early-blight), [late blight](/diseases/late-blight), [tomato leaf curl](/diseases/tomato-leaf-curl), [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** 36 t/ha in the dry season but under 10 t/ha in the wet season in registration trials.
**Fruit:** Rounded, about 7 cm long and 4 to 4.6 cm across.
Moderately resistant to fruitworm, leaf miner and bacterial wilt.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: nSIC registered DA BPI tomato, no current seller found. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant AniMax 1 tomato

It is recommended for Luzon. Bacterial wilt kills more lowland tomato than any other disease, so in the wet season pick a variety rated resistant to it. Choose a firm, oblong fruit if you sell to a far market, and a round, juicy one for fresh sale nearby. Heat tolerant hybrids set fruit in the hot months, when open pollinated tomatoes often drop their flowers. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for vegetables](/land-preparation/vegetable-land-preparation).
